campaign.title: Validate the profile certificate and signed endpoint packet

conductor_policy.claimant_routing: Every review is routed away from the Round-6 claimant; the two central lemmas are rederived from statement-only briefs.
conductor_policy.round_close: Promote only the independently reproduced statements whose normalization, signs, endpoint scope, and downstream implications all pass.

numerical_purpose: falsify an exact finite identity or endpoint scope claim
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: No asymptotic statement may be certified numerically.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary sources only and only when a source theorem is actually invoked.

frozen_candidates.profile: An explicit exact dyadic partition of 1<=d<=floor(sqrt X) has uniform discrete BV <=4, sampled l1 mass >=D/8 on every active block, and exactly one non-smooth continuum endpoint block.
frozen_candidates.packet: After removing gcd(h,k)>=L^(1/2), the balanced smooth endpoint sum is exactly a fixed dyadic sum of signed differences of 1/4 and 3/4 Poisson resonance packets in g=gcd(h,k).
frozen_candidates.direct_no_go: A fixed smooth profile still has D/L classwise one-sided first-annulus capacity; this obstructs absolute/classwise methods but is not a lower bound for the full signed block.

exit_gates: statement-only profile rederivation or exact counterexample
statement-only signed packet and sign rederivation or exact counterexample
hostile audit of classwise annulus and square-transition scope
endpoint versus interior Poisson seam classified
all proposed graph effects matched to green validation entries
campaign.promotion_policy: Round 7 may promote scoped infrastructure, exact reductions, and rigorous obstructions. It may not promote endpoint uniformity or M9-M2 without a complete pointwise bound for every remaining L block.
